propositions: 827 duplicate bridge-echo comments across three Jira issues (REB-1567, REB-1931, REB-2605) carry no reconciler marker due to truncation cutting it off post-body, and must be removed by identifying truncated comments that lack the marker.

Truncated comments are identified by two conditions: body contains the reconciler's truncation suffix and body does NOT contain RECONCILER_MARKER; the erroneous length check against rendered text (32767 chars) was corrected and not applied.

For each distinct normalized body, the oldest copy (lowest Jira comment id) is kept as the sole survivor; keep-one rule must invert on the final sweep after bridge re-enable to preserve the newest copy that the bridge records in comment_ids.

After re-enabling the bridge, the first pass will re-post approximately 8 fresh copies per distinct truncated comment (one per body) due to empty comment_ids at execution time, then dedupe from pass 2 onward; this re-post is expected, not a regression.
Backup completeness and zero data loss verified by closed reconciliation: backup minus deleted equals observed after on all three issues independently (145→7, 298→22, 430→16).
